mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE n.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND n.read_at IS NULL AND NOT ( n.type = 'MESSAGE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM message_room_user_settings s WHERE s.user_id = n.recipient_user_id AND s.muted = TRUE AND s.room_id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(n.link_url, 'messageRoomId=', -1), '&', 1) AS UNSIGNED) ) )

SELECT n.id, n.recipient_user_id, n.sender_user_id, s.name AS sender_name, n.type, n.title, n.body, n.link_url, n.read_at, n.created_at FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN users s ON s.id = n.sender_user_id WHERE n.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND NOT ( n.type = 'MESSAGE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM message_room_user_settings rs WHERE rs.user_id = n.recipient_user_id AND rs.muted = TRUE AND rs.room_id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(n.link_url, 'messageRoomId=', -1), '&', 1) AS UNSIGNED) ) ) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC

SELECT an.id, an.title, an.body, an.allow_anonymous, an.link_url, an.active, an.created_by, creator.name AS created_by_name, an.updated_by, updater.name AS updated_by_name, an.created_at, an.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE n.notice_id = an.id) AS recipient_count, np.start_date AS poll_start_date, np.end_date AS poll_end_date FROM admin_notices an JOIN users creator ON creator.id = an.created_by LEFT JOIN users updater ON updater.id = an.updated_by LEFT JOIN notice_polls np ON np.notice_id = an.id ORDER BY an.active DESC, an.created_at DESC, an.id DESC

SELECT an.id, an.title, an.body, an.allow_anonymous, an.link_url, an.active, an.created_by, creator.name AS created_by_name, an.updated_by, updater.name AS updated_by_name, an.created_at, an.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE n.notice_id = an.id) AS recipient_count, np.start_date AS poll_start_date, np.end_date AS poll_end_date FROM admin_notices an JOIN users creator ON creator.id = an.created_by LEFT JOIN users updater ON updater.id = an.updated_by LEFT JOIN notice_polls np ON np.notice_id = an.id WHERE an.id = #{id}

SELECT an.id AS id, an.created_by AS sender_user_id, creator.name AS sender_name, 'ADMIN_NOTICE' AS type, an.title AS title, an.body AS body, CONCAT('/notices/', an.id) AS link_url, (SELECT MIN(n.read_at) FROM notifications n WHERE n.notice_id = an.id AND n.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND n.type = 'ADMIN_NOTICE') AS read_at, an.created_at AS created_at, np.start_date AS poll_start_date, np.end_date AS poll_end_date FROM admin_notices an JOIN users creator ON creator.id = an.created_by LEFT JOIN notice_polls np ON np.notice_id = an.id WHERE an.active = TRUE ORDER BY an.created_at DESC, an.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_notices(title, body, allow_anonymous, link_url, active, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{title}, #{body}, #{allowAnonymous}, #{linkUrl}, TRUE, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_notices SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, allow_anonymous = #{allowAnonymous}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, active = #{active}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications(recipient_user_id, sender_user_id, type, title, body, link_url) VALUES(#{recipientUserId}, #{senderUserId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{linkUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, NOW()) WHERE recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'MESSAGE' AND read_at IS NULL AND link_url LIKE CONCAT('%messageRoomId=', #{roomId}, '%')
UPDATE notifications SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, NOW()) WHERE recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'WORK_MEMO' AND read_at IS NULL AND link_url LIKE CONCAT('%/work-memos/', #{memoId}, '%')
UPDATE notifications SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, NOW()) WHERE recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_room_members mrm JOIN message_messages mm ON mm.room_id = mrm.room_id WHERE mrm.user_id = #{userId} AND (mm.sender_user_id IS NULL OR mm.sender_user_id != #{userId}) AND mm.id > COALESCE(mrm.last_read_message_id, 0)

SELECT mr.id, mr.title, mr.created_by, creator.name AS created_by_name, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.id != #{userId} THEN u.name END ORDER BY u.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS member_names, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_messages unread WHERE unread.room_id = mr.id AND (unread.sender_user_id IS NULL OR unread.sender_user_id != #{userId}) AND unread.id > COALESCE(current_member.last_read_message_id, 0) ), 0) AS unread_count, CASE WHEN last_message.body IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(last_message.body) != '' THEN last_message.body ELSE ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN attachment_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '이미지를 보냈습니다' WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '파일을 보냈습니다' ELSE NULL END FROM message_attachments WHERE message_id = last_message.id ) END AS last_message_body, last_message.created_at AS last_message_at, settings.custom_title, COALESCE(settings.pinned, FALSE) AS pinned, COALESCE(settings.muted, FALSE) AS muted, COALESCE(settings.opacity_percent, 100) AS opacity_percent FROM message_rooms mr JOIN message_room_members current_member ON current_member.room_id = mr.id AND current_member.user_id = #{userId} JOIN message_room_members all_members ON all_members.room_id = mr.id JOIN users u ON u.id = all_members.user_id JOIN users creator ON creator.id = mr.created_by LEFT JOIN message_room_user_settings settings ON settings.room_id = mr.id AND settings.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN message_messages last_message ON last_message.id = ( SELECT MAX(mm.id) FROM message_messages mm WHERE mm.room_id = mr.id ) GROUP BY mr.id, mr.title, mr.created_by, creator.name, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, current_member.last_read_message_id, last_message.id, last_message.body, last_message.created_at, settings.custom_title, settings.pinned, settings.muted, settings.opacity_percent ORDER BY COALESCE(settings.pinned, FALSE) DESC, COALESCE(last_message.created_at, mr.updated_at) DESC, mr.id DESC

SELECT mr.id, mr.title, mr.created_by, creator.name AS created_by_name, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.id != #{userId} THEN u.name END ORDER BY u.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS member_names, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_messages unread JOIN message_room_members current_member ON current_member.room_id = unread.room_id AND current_member.user_id = #{userId} WHERE unread.room_id = mr.id AND (unread.sender_user_id IS NULL OR unread.sender_user_id != #{userId}) AND unread.id > COALESCE(current_member.last_read_message_id, 0) ), 0) AS unread_count, settings.custom_title, COALESCE(settings.pinned, FALSE) AS pinned, COALESCE(settings.muted, FALSE) AS muted, COALESCE(settings.opacity_percent, 100) AS opacity_percent FROM message_rooms mr JOIN message_room_members viewer ON viewer.room_id = mr.id AND viewer.user_id = #{userId} JOIN message_room_members all_members ON all_members.room_id = mr.id JOIN users u ON u.id = all_members.user_id JOIN users creator ON creator.id = mr.created_by LEFT JOIN message_room_user_settings settings ON settings.room_id = mr.id AND settings.user_id = #{userId} WHERE mr.id = #{roomId} GROUP BY mr.id, mr.title, mr.created_by, creator.name, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, settings.custom_title, settings.pinned, settings.muted, settings.opacity_percent

SELECT mr.id FROM message_rooms mr JOIN message_room_members mine ON mine.room_id = mr.id AND mine.user_id = #{userId} JOIN message_room_members target ON target.room_id = mr.id AND target.user_id = #{recipientUserId} WHERE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_room_members members WHERE members.room_id = mr.id ) = 2 ORDER BY mr.updated_at DESC, mr.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT mrm.room_id, mrm.user_id, u.name AS user_name, t.name AS team_name, u.profile_image_filename, mrm.last_read_message_id, mrm.created_at FROM message_room_members mrm JOIN users u ON u.id = mrm.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE mrm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY u.name
SELECT user_id FROM message_room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY user_id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.team_id, t.code AS team_code, t.name AS team_name, u.dept, u.profile_image_filename, u.active FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE u.active = TRUE AND u.id != #{currentUserId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM message_room_members mrm WHERE mrm.room_id = #{roomId} AND mrm.user_id = u.id ) ORDER BY t.display_order, u.name
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO message_room_members(room_id, user_id) VALUES(#{roomId}, #{userId})
INSERT INTO message_messages(room_id, sender_user_id, body) VALUES(#{roomId}, #{senderUserId}, #{body})

INSERT INTO message_attachments(message_id, room_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, file_size, attachment_type, expires_at) VALUES(#{messageId}, #{roomId}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{attachmentType}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT mm.id, mm.room_id, mm.sender_user_id, u.name AS sender_name, u.profile_image_filename AS sender_profile_image_filename, mm.body, mm.created_at FROM message_messages mm LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = mm.sender_user_id WHERE mm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY mm.created_at, mm.id

SELECT mm.id, mm.room_id, mm.sender_user_id, u.name AS sender_name, u.profile_image_filename AS sender_profile_image_filename, mm.body, mm.created_at FROM message_messages mm LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = mm.sender_user_id WHERE mm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC, mm.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT mm.id, mm.room_id, mm.sender_user_id, u.name AS sender_name, u.profile_image_filename AS sender_profile_image_filename, mm.body, mm.created_at FROM message_messages mm LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = mm.sender_user_id WHERE mm.room_id = #{roomId} AND mm.id < #{beforeId} ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC, mm.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM message_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND id < #{beforeId})
SELECT id, message_id, room_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, file_size, attachment_type, expires_at, created_at FROM message_attachments WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, message_id, room_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, file_size, attachment_type, expires_at, created_at FROM message_attachments WHERE expires_at < NOW() LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_room_user_settings(room_id, user_id, custom_title, pinned, muted, opacity_percent) VALUES(#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{customTitle}, #{pinned}, #{muted}, #{opacityPercent}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE custom_title = VALUES(custom_title), pinned = VALUES(pinned), muted = VALUES(muted), opacity_percent = VALUES(opacity_percent)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE system_account = TRUE

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT t.id AS team_id, t.id AS ancestor_id, t.parent_id, t.name, t.display_order, 0 AS depth FROM teams t WHERE t.active = TRUE UNION ALL SELECT ancestors.team_id, parent.id AS ancestor_id, parent.parent_id, parent.name, parent.display_order, ancestors.depth + 1 AS depth FROM ancestors JOIN teams parent ON parent.id = ancestors.parent_id WHERE parent.active = TRUE ), top_groups AS ( SELECT ancestors.team_id, ancestors.name AS org_group_name, ancestors.display_order AS org_group_order FROM ancestors JOIN teams parent ON parent.id = ancestors.parent_id WHERE parent.parent_id IS NULL ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.team_id, t.code AS team_code, t.name AS team_name, u.dept, u.extension_number, u.mobile_number, u.job_title, u.email, u.profile_image_filename, u.contractor, COALESCE(tg.org_group_name, t.name, '미지정') AS org_group_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_holidays ch WHERE ch.holiday_date = #{today}) THEN 'HOLIDAY' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM leave_requests lr WHERE lr.user_id = u.id AND lr.status IN ('APPROVED', 'CANCEL_PENDING') AND lr.start_date <= #{today} AND lr.end_date >= #{today} ) THEN 'LEAVE' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM business_trips bt WHERE bt.user_id = u.id AND bt.status = 'APPROVED' AND bt.start_date <= #{today} AND bt.end_date >= #{today} ) THEN 'BUSINESS_TRIP' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outside_work_requests ow WHERE ow.user_id = u.id AND ow.status = 'APPROVED' AND ow.work_date = #{today} AND CURRENT_TIME() >= ow.out_time AND CURRENT_TIME() < ow.end_time ) THEN 'OUTSIDE' WHEN ar.check_in_at IS NOT NULL AND ar.check_out_at IS NULL THEN 'WORKING' WHEN ar.check_in_at IS NOT NULL AND ar.check_out_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'OFF_WORK' WHEN ar.status IS NOT NULL THEN ar.status WHEN CURRENT_TIME() > COALESCE((SELECT ats.default_start_time FROM attendance_settings ats WHERE ats.id = 1), '09:00:00') THEN 'ABSENT' ELSE 'SCHEDULED' END AS status FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id LEFT JOIN top_groups tg ON tg.team_id = t.id LEFT JOIN attendance_records ar ON ar.user_id = u.id AND ar.work_date = #{today} WHERE u.active = TRUE ORDER BY COALESCE(tg.org_group_order, t.display_order, 9999), t.display_order, u.member_order, u.name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poll_votes WHERE option_id = #{optionId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice_comments(notice_id, parent_id, body, anonymous, author_user_id, author_token) VALUES(#{noticeId}, #{parentId}, #{body}, #{anonymous}, #{authorUserId}, #{authorToken})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.notice_id, c.parent_id, c.body, c.anonymous, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN NULL ELSE c.author_user_id END AS author_user_id, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN '익명' ELSE u.name END AS author_name, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN NULL ELSE u.profile_image_filename END AS author_profile_image, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN NULL ELSE t.name END AS author_team_name, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN NULL ELSE u.dept END AS author_dept, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN NULL ELSE u.job_title END AS author_job_title, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN NULL ELSE u.extension_number END AS author_extension_number, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN NULL ELSE u.mobile_number END AS author_mobile_number, CASE WHEN c.anonymous = TRUE THEN NULL ELSE u.email END AS author_email FROM notice_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE c.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND c.active = TRUE ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
SELECT id, notice_id, parent_id, body, anonymous, author_user_id, created_at FROM notice_comments WHERE id = #{id} AND active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE notice_comments SET active = FALSE WHERE id = #{id}
